title: Global functions on a proper curve
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $C$ be a proper connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves] (a nonempty, connected, one-dimensional separated $k$-scheme of finite type, proper over $k$) which is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. Let $H^0(C,\mathcal O_C)=\Gamma(C,\mathcal O_C)$ be a $k$-algebra through the structure morphism $C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. Then the structure map $k\to H^0(C,\mathcal O_C)$ is bijective:

$$
H^0(C,\mathcal O_C)=k.
$$

In particular this holds for every proper smooth connected curve $C$ over $k$ [def-sc-curves].

proof.text: *$H^0$ is finite-dimensional* (Tag 0BUG (1)). $C$ is of finite type over the field $k$, hence locally Noetherian (it is covered by spectra of finitely generated $k$-algebras, which are Noetherian by the Hilbert basis theorem), and $\mathcal O_C$ is quasi-coherent of finite type (generated by $1$), hence coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]. The structure morphism $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is proper and $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is the spectrum of the Noetherian ring $k$, so by the last clause of [lem-pc-coherent-hi] (Tag 02O6) $A:=H^0(C,\mathcal O_C)$ is a finite $k$-module. Thus $A$ is a commutative $k$-algebra, finite-dimensional as a $k$-vector space.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 33.9.3, Tag 0BUG (label lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), proof, first paragraph (proof of (1), citing Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.19.2, Tag 02O6)

proof.text: *$A$ is reduced and nonzero* (Tag 0BUG (3), first sentence: 'If $X$ is reduced, then $A$ is reduced'). By [def-pc-reduced-scheme], $\mathcal O_C(U)$ is a reduced ring for every open $U\subseteq C$; for $U=C$ this says that $A$ has no nonzero nilpotent element. $C$ is nonempty (a connected curve is nonempty, [def-sc-curves]); pick $x\in C$; the ring map $A\to\mathcal O_{C,x}$ sends $1$ to $1\neq0$ (a local ring is nonzero), so $1\neq0$ in $A$.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 33.9.3, Tag 0BUG (label lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), proof, third paragraph

proof.text: *$A$ has no nontrivial idempotents* (Tag 0BUG (2): idempotents of $A$ correspond to decompositions $X=Y\amalg Z$ into open subschemes). $C$ is a nonempty connected scheme, so by [lem-pc-scheme-connected-iff-idempotents] the only idempotents $e=e^2$ of $A=\Gamma(C,\mathcal O_C)$ are $0$ and $1$.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 33.9.3, Tag 0BUG (label lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), proof, second paragraph (proof of (2))

proof.text: *Conclusion* (Tag 0BUG (2), (3): a finite-dimensional $k$-algebra is a product of Artinian local $k$-algebras (Algebra, Tags 00J6, 00KJ), reduced ones are fields (Tag 00EU), one factor for each connected component; here one factor, a finite extension of $k$, which equals $k$ as $k$ is algebraically closed). By Steps 1–3, $A$ is a commutative $k$-algebra that is finite-dimensional over $k$, reduced, not the zero ring, and whose only idempotents are $0$ and $1$; $k$ is algebraically closed. By [lem-pc-alg-closed-reduced-algebra-no-idempotents-dim-one], $\dim_kA=1$ and the structure map $k\to A=H^0(C,\mathcal O_C)$ is bijective.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 33.9.3, Tag 0BUG (label lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), proof, second and third paragraphs (proof of (2) and (3)), specialized to one connected component and to $k$ algebraically closed

proof.text: *Smooth curves* (the last sentence of the statement). Let $C$ be a proper smooth connected curve over $k$. By [lem-sc-smooth-regular] every local ring $\mathcal O_{C,P}$ is regular, hence a domain, hence reduced; so $C$ is reduced by [def-pc-reduced-scheme] (reducedness of all local rings). Steps 1–4 apply to $C$ and give $H^0(C,\mathcal O_C)=k$.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 33.25.3, Tag 056S (label lemma-smooth-regular): a scheme smooth over a field is regular

proof_origin.place: Varieties, Lemma 33.9.3, Tag 0BUG (label lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), proof (parts (1), (2), (3), specialized to $k$ algebraically closed and $X$ connected and reduced)

statement_change.what: added the hypothesis that $C$ is reduced, and the clause that every proper smooth connected curve satisfies it; the imported statement is false for non-reduced curves: def-sc-curves allows a non-reduced connected curve, and for $C=\mathbf P^1_k\times_k\operatorname{Spec}k[\varepsilon]/(\varepsilon^2)$ (proper, connected, of dimension one) $H^0(C,\mathcal O_C)=k[\varepsilon]/(\varepsilon^2)\neq k$ (Stacks 0BUG (3) and (7) need reducedness). Every citer (lem-sc-riemann-roch, lem-sc-canonical-degree, lem-wf-curve-kummer-jacobian-tate-module, lem-fin-projective-curve-betti-cardinalities, lem-sc-affine-unit-quotient, lem-sc-units-quotient-base-change) applies it to a proper smooth connected curve, covered by the last sentence; the Lean declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlobalSectionsBijective.of_isAlgClosed of slopmaster2 states the reduced version.

split_report.summary: The imported statement is false for non-reduced proper connected curves (P^1 x Spec k[e]/(e^2) has H^0 = k[e]/(e^2)), which def-sc-curves allows; restated with C reduced, plus the clause for proper smooth connected curves, which is what all six citers use (statement_change). The blueprint proof (a non-constant global function gives a morphism to A^1 with finite image) is replaced by the proof of Stacks 0BUG (1)-(3) (read with its citations 02O6, 00J6, 00KJ, 00EU): H^0 is finite-dimensional by finiteness of coherent cohomology (lem-pc-coherent-hi, with O_C coherent by pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth), reduced since C is, without nontrivial idempotents since C is connected (lem-pc-scheme-connected-iff-idempotents, Lean closed), hence equal to k (lem-pc-alg-closed-reduced-algebra-no-idempotents-dim-one, Lean closed, which carries 00J6/00KJ/00EU); smooth implies reduced by lem-sc-smooth-regular (Lean closed). The blueprint's uses lem-sc-morphism-from-function and lem-sc-proper-affine-finite are no longer used. No new node. The slopmaster2 declaration GlobalSectionsBijective.of_isAlgClosed states exactly the reduced clause and rests on sorry through its open entries: exists_addEquiv_sections_higherDirectImage_H belongs to lem-pc-cohomology-sections-affine-base (which already records it as sorry_here), finite_sections_higherDirectImage belongs to lem-pc-coherent-hi (already recorded).
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the conclusion of the blueprint proof of lem-sc-global-functions ('f is constant, i.e. f in k') by another argument: the blueprint's single paragraph (a global function defines a morphism from C to A^1, whose image is proper and affine, hence finite, hence a point since C is connected) is replaced by Stacks 0BUG (1)-(3); the blueprint argument tacitly needs C reduced (a nilpotent function maps C to the point 0 without being constant).

tool_uses.why: Step 1 takes finite-dimensionality of H^0 of a coherent module on a proper k-scheme (Tag 02O6, the citation of 0BUG (1)); no node of sk-prop-cd-affine states it.
Step 1 takes that O_C is coherent on the locally Noetherian C (Tag 01XZ); generic tool, no node of the unit states it.
